fields.Name: T083 - Grid Row Multi-Selection State
fields.Description: Isolates the grid row-selection model (selection count + selection-gated toolbar enablement); existing bulk tests jump straight into the Add-to-List dialog rather than verifying the selection mechanism itself.

InputDefinition.goal: Open the application switcher dropdown next to the logo and go to Data Explorer > Data. Open the 'Products' entity via the LEFT sidebar 'Search entities...' box (type 'Products', click the exact match). Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained environment — wait, don't navigate away. In the records grid, select one or more rows using their row checkboxes (use the header select-all checkbox to select multiple if rows are present). Success is the grid reflecting the selection — a selection count appears (e.g. '(1 selected)' / '(2 selected)') and/or selection-dependent toolbar actions (such as Add to List / Delete) become enabled. If the grid is empty, a valid empty-state is acceptable. You do NOT need to run any of those actions.

judgeValidationCriteria: Selecting one or more rows via the checkboxes updates the grid selection state — a selection count and/or highlighted rows appear (or a valid empty-state renders if there are no rows)
At least one selection-dependent toolbar control becomes enabled once a row is selected, OR the selection count is clearly displayed
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
